verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal explicitly lets developers browse/search API docs and 'try API operations,' and OpenAPI spec directories exist, indicating an interactive reference; Insomnia also supports importing OpenAPI specs and running requests. However, no direct evidence of a polished, AI-native runnable-example experience with agentic exploration (e.g., embedded code execution, live sandbox) is shown, and the Dev Portal claim is unverified by hands-on probes.
